Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

Please find 3 packages below. Each of them works for us; let us know which one suits you best.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge the positive development in your demand forecast and have factored this volume increase into our calculation.

Our offer stands at a price of €371.81 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Building on your third package, we are prepared to extend the payment terms to 45 days at a unit price of €370.78, with no Preisgleitklausel. This offer passes on the volume benefits while balancing the extended payment period. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

We have carefully reviewed your revised proposal; however, without new verifiable data, we cannot justify further concessions. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our terms remain a price of €373.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Our offer of €373.88 for 90 days payment terms remains firm. 

Should you prefer a lower unit price, we remain open to discussing shorter payment terms. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
